# Jcorp Studios

> Jcorp Studios is a small independent game studio building handcrafted games. We ship in the open and are transparent about using AI tools in development, always under human direction and review.

Website: https://jcorpstudios.com

## Games

- [Everdeep](https://jcorpstudios.com/games/everdeep/): A roguelite descent into a world that eats. Three weapons (sword, boomerang, sling), each the counter to a foe family, wielded down through five biomes toward the Heart at the bottom. Engine: Unity. Platforms: PC and mobile. Status: in development.
- [Ninja Shuriken: Yokai Rush](https://jcorpstudios.com/games/ninja-shuriken/): A free one-thumb Action arcade game for iPhone and iPad. Tap to throw shuriken, guard the village, hold the combo, and chase the Game Center leaderboard. No ads. Engine: Godot. Available on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ninja-shuriken-yokai-rush/id6796070513).
- [Pong](https://jcorpstudios.com/games/pong/): The arcade classic, rebuilt with real game feel and crisp paddle physics. Engine: Godot. Platforms: Windows and Mac. Status: in development.
- [Tetris](https://jcorpstudios.com/games/tetris/): The falling-block puzzle classic, sharpened — pixel-crisp blocks, smooth glide-and-lock, and a rebuilt Korobeiniki theme. Engine: Godot. Platforms: Windows. Status: in playtest.

## Devblog

- [Devblog](https://jcorpstudios.com/reports/): Weekly build-by-build development notes for each game, published in the open.

## About

- Independent studio; games built by hand, one slice at a time.
- Transparent about AI use: AI assists with art, code, and iteration; all outputs are human-directed, reviewed, and quality-gated.
- Contact: gary@leewyattcorp.com
